requirements.title: bar状态与序列状态的关系明确

requirements.acceptance: 同物理端点/上下文评价；短前缀冷启动、完整滚动与长期记忆分开。

requirements.title: 价格与数据处理可追溯

requirements.acceptance: 每轮协议绑定原始数据和统计来源；数据窗口/标签和缓存核对；没有独立复算的部分注明。

requirements.title: 状态可复用，可支持分类/趋势/波动等用途
requirements.requirement: 当前主验收之一：冻结embedding验证多种只依赖过去的行情描述/复用，匹配简单统计/PCA/原始输入与读头机会；不把某一规则拟合当全部目标。
requirements.acceptance: 同权重、同读取机会及事前门槛；历史状态描述不等于未来收益或开仓建议。

requirements.title: 保留未来逐bar外推方向

requirements.acceptance: 未来用途单独验收并检查z、因子、融合和同信息原历史增益；当前历史/状态交付不依赖预测通过，未评价不得标失败。

mathematics.conditional_gap: E KL(p(Y|H,M,F)||p(Y|Z,M,F))=I(Y;H|Z,M,F) under deterministic Z and well-defined expectations
mathematics.counterexample: independent fair H,F; Y=H xor F. I(Y;H)=0, I(Y;H|F)=1bit. Constant Z loses no H-only forecast value but loses the one-bit combined value.
mathematics.interpretation: supports retaining broad history before selecting solely for H-only predictions; not evidence markets obey XOR or measured Babel synergy

retained_forecast_design.decoder: 2-layer GRU256 conditioned on z; nu>2 conditional step variance=s^2*nu/(nu-2), not variance=s^2; scale floor fixed before runs; continuous-return approximation, no true future volume/OI
retained_forecast_design.objective: teacher-forced joint Student-t NLL of60 trading-minute log returns standardized by fixed origin sigma; real-prefix likelihood is exact chain scoring; marginal/free-generation evaluation separate

forecast_score_contract.targets: single-step and cumulative log returns at fixed horizons, path vector in fixed training coordinates; price quantiles/coverage for display
forecast_score_contract.joint_nll: sum of real-prefix conditional negative log densities equals realized-path joint NLL, not leakage at generation; generated prefixes do not give that exact joint score
forecast_score_contract.marginal_nll: requires integration of intermediate outcomes; one conditional Student-t is not a multistep marginal
forecast_score_contract.jacobian: u=r/sigma_t; NLL_r=NLL_u+log(sigma_t) per step, H log(sigma_t) per path; CRPS_r=sigma_t*CRPS_u
forecast_score_contract.crps: univariate marginal return scoring, finite first moment; not a joint temporal-dependence score
forecast_score_contract.energy_score: E||X-y||-.5 E||X-Xprime|| on independent complete return paths; fixed Euclidean coordinates/scales and finite first moment; common MC budget/errors not yet locked
forecast_score_contract.price_tail_limit: nondegenerate untruncated Student-t log return has infinite E[exp(R)]; no theoretical mean-price claims or price-CRPS requiring finite first moment; no silent sample clipping
forecast_score_contract.comparability: same frozen probability-head opportunities across arms; added path scoring is evaluation only, no new workers

retained_forecast_design.acceptance_proposal: old CRPS3pct remains an unlocked later-use proposal only

architecture_simplicity_review_20261125.trigger: 用户指出整体连接图很简单，要求架构理由更充分。
findings: Simple diagram does not imply weak model; existing size and module names do not prove adequacy.
Up to512 market states of width768 remain inside encoder blocks; single public endpoint is not early global collapse.
Same-source multiscale observations are not a learned hierarchy; relation bias does not guarantee overlap accounting.
Value-residual access does not guarantee content reaches public z.
Single768 state is a storage/organization starting assumption, not a proven sufficient or optimal state.
Input aggregation loses distinctions that decoder depth cannot uniquely recover from absent information.

discussion_candidate.contract: S_t=R(T_t) in R^(Kxd_s); z=vec(S_t); K*d_s=768; unchanged D(z,q)
discussion_candidate.essential_difference: multiple states read legal hidden history during compression, not reshape/project a completed z inside decoder
limits: flattening is bijective rearrangement, not more information
existing12head attention already supplies multiple reads
equal state scalars/precision is not equal parameters or compute
state semantics not assigned as trend/noise or order-flow identities
no extra state/KV bypass to historical head
comparison_requirements: same input, backbone, history head, losses, endpoint exposure and selection opportunity
explicit replacement or bounded new matrix decision before release
